result.summary: Kessler Traders GmbH has a consistent pattern of late payment, with settled invoices averaging 30-55 days late before a brief improvement to 10 days late. However, the current worst open invoice (INV001567) is already 60 days past due—worse than any prior settled invoice—signaling a fresh deterioration. With €430k credit limit last reviewed in Oct 2024 and ~€189k currently overdue/exposed, underwriters should reassess exposure and consider tightening terms.
concerns: Worst open invoice is 60 days past due, exceeding historical late-payment records
Credit limit (€430,000) has not been reviewed in over a year despite ongoing late-payment behavior
Payment history shows chronic lateness (46-55 days) with only one recent instance of near-on-time payment, making the trend unstable
Total open exposure (~€189,100) is significant relative to credit limit and should be monitored closely
